title: Code review
concept: Read Priya's comments, reply, request changes

story.speaker: Priya
story.text: I reviewed your PR. I left a comment.

hints: Look at Priya's comment in the GitHub view.

questions.prompt: What should you do when changes are requested?

choices.text: Make the changes and push to the same branch
Close the PR and give up

questions.explanation: Just add more commits to the branch.

recap: Code review is a normal part of working in a team.
